VibeSpace by Tront

VibeSpace is a particle space simulation in Three.js: bodies drifting, attracting and streaking across the view, rendered as a live particle field.

One page, no install. By Tront (Trent Sterling), one of a set of small browser experiments.

More from Tront

  • VibeSand: WebGPU falling-sand simulation: two million voxels updating at 60fps.
  • VibeBounce: Ray propagation with bouncing physics through a procedural voxel world, on a sparse voxel octree.
  • Quantum Vibes: Interactive quantum mechanics: the double-slit experiment and Feynman path integrals in the browser.
